{{Top|leg}}
A '''temperature sensor''', '''thermo-sensor''',<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> or '''temperature receptor''',<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that measured temperature levels. They were usually found in control stations monitoring interior environments.

Temperature sensors could also be added to [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometers]] like the [[MicroThrust Processors|MicroThrust]] [[Clockwatcher]] for an extra ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="GFT" />
